Table cells line objects

Source: R/zz-gen-table.R
go_table_cells_line.Rd

The object for the cells.line of a table trace (go_table_cells()). go_table_cells_line() creates one, with exactly its properties; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_table_cells_line(..., color = NULL, width = NULL, skip_invalid = FALSE)

Arguments

...

Not for properties, which must be named in full: an abbreviated or unknown name is an error that suggests the right one.

color

Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

width

Number, or a vector of these.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_table_cells_line object (a named list).

Details

Nested objects are named lists, or objects of the constructors their arguments name. Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when the object is created or modified. A property may be a one-sided formula (color = ~col): it is kept, and evaluated in the data (then checked) when its trace is added to a figure with add_<trace>() or add_trace().

Examples

go_table(
  cells = go_table_cells(
    line = go_table_cells_line(color = "red")
  )
)
#> <go_table>
#> {
#>   "type": "table",
#>   "cells": {
#>     "line": {
#>       "color": "red"
#>     }
#>   }
#> }
#>
